description: This file defines the AppDatabase class for the BudgetBuddy Android app, which is a Room database setup primarily storing ExpenseEntity objects and providing a singleton instance via getInstance method.

classes.name: AppDatabase
classes.description: Abstract class extending RoomDatabase, serving as the main access point to the Room database, including an abstract method expenseDao() to access expense data.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides a thread-safe singleton instance of AppDatabase, initializing it if it does not already exist.
